description: Get the details of one Krew Guru vacancy by its vac_id: rank, vessel type and size, salary range in USD per month (net), contract length, boarding date and port, requirements (citizenship, English level, certificates, visas) and a vacancy_url to open it on krew.guru. Use this when the seafarer wants more about a vacancy returned by search_maritime_jobs or by create_seafarer_profile_draft (matched_vacancies). Do not use for searching (use search_maritime_jobs) or for company contact details, which are not returned.

vac_id.description: Vacancy id (vac_id) from search_maritime_jobs or matched_vacancies.
